shellCommands.command: ls -la && git log --stat | head -30 && cat package.json 2>/dev/null; head -c 600 package-lock.json; node --version

export BOOKS_FILE=/tmp/smoke/books.json PORT=3456; rm -rf /tmp/smoke
node server.js & P=$!; sleep 0.5
curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code} %{redirect_url}\n' -d 'title=Middlemarch&author=George Eliot&notes=Slow start, worth it.' localhost:$PORT/books
ID=$(node -e "console.log(JSON.parse(require('fs').readFileSync('$BOOKS_FILE')).at(0).id)")
curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code} %{redirect_url}\n' -d 'from=home' localhost:$PORT/books/$ID/finish
kill $P; wait $P 2>/dev/null
node server.js & P=$!; sleep 0.5
curl -s localhost:$PORT/books/$ID | sed -n '/<h2>/,/All books/p'
kill $P; cat $BOOKS_FILE
